dialogs.notes: Read from the vendor article on the new reports menu (dialog screenshots). The document lists it under the SELECT picker dialogs without naming the control that opens it; CODES > SELECT of the Production Report is the code picker of these screens, and the same article shows the Production Report criteria states. SEARCH TEXT / CLEAR SEARCH, >> / <<, the access note and APPLY / CANCEL are listed only for SEARCH OFFICES; whether this dialog has them too is not stated. That the 14 categories are the domain of the Category criteria on other screens is marked unverified in the document, and whether CODE/CATEGORY on the Special Transaction Report opens this same dialog is not stated. The dialog was read from the Daily Reports screens; that the CODES picker of the My Reports Production Report opens the same dialog is presumed, not shown.
